messages:
Sam: Pinging the group to capture a compact rollforward/rollback contract for hosted/dedicated/private. Goal: predictable failure domains and minimal operator toil.
Rina: Agree. Distinguish API parity vs behavior parity. We should aim for behavior parity (observable + rollback semantics) rather than identical internals.
Devon: Implementation note: private installs will be slower to react and may not accept remote control-plane commands. Plan for delegated local-agent enforcement.
Leo: Proposal: encode a tiny state machine in the deployment manifest: {desired_version, rollback_target, roll_policy}. Agents reconcile and emit signed events.
Sam: For routing, use tenant affinity tokens with TTL. New variant gets new token; rollback sets TTL=0 so new requests favor the previous variant while existing sessions continue.
Rina: For streaming sessions we should drain new-accepts for a timeout window rather than cutting existing streams. Add per-deployment drain_seconds.
Devon: Observability triggers: token-level error-rate spike, P99 latency increase, and quality regressions from eval hooks. Private gets local-eval-agent to sign and report deltas.
Sam: Auto-rollback draft: trigger if token-error-rate > 2.5x baseline for 4m OR P99 > +200ms for 5m. For cross-plane changes require human approval.
Leo: Schema-only changes should attempt auto-shim translation on apply; if shim fails, reject the manifest to avoid full rollbacks.
Rina: Security: all rollback actions must be auditable, signed, and RBAC-scoped. Dedicated/private agent certs map to tenant identity.
Devon: SDK opt-out header idea: X-RW-Rollback-Policy: default|opt_out|strict. If opt_out, client sessions maintain affinity and ignore auto-routing flips for that session. Limit opt_out by TTL and key scope.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary run 3965550025 to validate rollback TTL behavior in staging.
Sam: Next steps: Rina draft a 1-page RFC with the decision matrix and playbook checklist; Devon prototype local-eval-agent ack schema; Leo sketch manifest state machine fields. Reconvene after RFC review.
